lead.billing: ChatGPT-authenticated subscription route; the bridge removes OpenAI API keys

qualityPolicy.quotaObjective: Preserve the user's Codex plan quota by assigning suitable bounded work to a cheaper DeepSeek worker when equivalent quality can be demonstrated.
qualityPolicy.leadInvariant: ChatGPT Codex always remains the lead agent: it plans, chooses any worker, verifies the evidence, integrates the result, and answers the user.
qualityPolicy.rule: Prefer a lower-cost DeepSeek worker when the task is bounded and Codex can demonstrate that its result meets the same acceptance criteria without lowering the bar.
qualityPolicy.fallback: If verification fails, context transfer is lossy, or quality parity is uncertain, Codex must redo or complete the work itself.
qualityPolicy.primaryPolicy: Never select or recommend DeepSeek as the primary agent under this policy; DeepSeek models are workers behind the Codex lead.

models.name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash

tasks whose correctness cannot be independently checked

useFor: work where Flash rework risk outweighs Pro's extra cost
avoidFor: routine work that Flash can satisfy and Codex can verify
